findings.text: `Servex/agents/readme.md` doesn't mention the new behaviour or its test. Around line 73, where `send_to_agent` to a tab is described with `External.test.mjs`, add one line: "`send_to_agent` takes `{to, message}` as well as `{id, text}`; a missing recipient names the field. Test: `send-alias.test.mjs`. Needs a Servex restart." As it stands, the new test is unindexed, and nothing says the change only takes effect after a restart.

`public/framework/tasks/readme.md:37`: the heading is struck through as solved, but its sub-bullets still say "To find: which tool or wording they read". The 16:51 and 16:53 reports (v1-2-scroll-fix, process-runner-stall) may have used `{to, message}` or may have had another cause. Either trim the sub-bullets or say that this cause covers those two reports.

There's no simpler way: aliasing in the handler and dropping `required` is the smallest change. The older comment at `Servex/agents/tools.js` ("a call with `message` instead of `text` delivered the word 'undefined'… (09-29)") now describes a case that the alias accepts. It is still true history but could mislead; one clause saying "now accepted as an alias" would help.

The task folder holds only `requirements.md`. A fresh agent has to find the branch `worktree/send-alias` (`C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/send-alias`, commit 14b3586f5) through `git worktree list`. Naming the branch in requirements.md, or in a task.jsonl, would let someone continue from the folder alone.
